I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket number is PD-4821.

The source is Hollis's Jun 9 message in #central-team, which says that ticket has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he could see this himself. I also mentioned the snag Hollis raised: the import file labels doors E1/E2 but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be sorted out before anyone reimported it. I didn't find anything saying it has been fixed since.
